full_judgment: One Bina Pani Roy daughter of late Janaki Lal Roy and mother of the present petitioners and proforma opposite-party No. 6 instituted Title Suit No. 259 of 1967 against one Md. Ishaque Mia the predecessor-in-interest of opposite party Nos. 1-5 in the Court of the Munsif now Assistant Judge. Thakurgaon, for declaration of their title and recovery of khas possession in the suit land as described in the schedule of the plaint. Plaintiffs case, in short, is that the suit property is a residential plot within Thakurgaon town which originally belonged to one Janaki Lal Roy, a pleader of Thakurgaou Court who used to live in the house situated on the suit land to carry on his legal profession. In 1370, his wife died and subsequently he also died in 1371 B.S. His only son Jotish Chandra Roy became completely insane and his whereabouts were unknown. The said Janaki Lal Roy brought his only daughter Bina Pani Roy with her husband and children to live with him. After the death of the said Janaki Lai Roy, Bina Pani Roy the plaintiff inherited the suit property and was living therein by making further construction. But on the 14th Ashwin 1374 B.S. one Md. Ishaque Mia, the defendant of the suit being encouraged by and with the help of some other hired persons dispossessed her along with the members of her family from the suit land and forcibly occupied the same. Hence the suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession.
